fact: The Ministry of the Interior launched an online digital services portal, fully operational from 15 December 2025, hosting applications for immigrant quota permits, citizenship renunciation, dual nationality, naturalisation and licensing, with tracking and automated payments, as the Interior Minister said.
system: Interior Ministry online digital services portal

fact: The policy states the Ghana.gov portal centralizes access to government services such as tax filings, business registrations and passport applications, and an e-Payment portal supports payment for government services.
DIAL reports Ghana.gov is the portal where users discover, consume and pay for government services, and most of renewing a driver's license or passport can be done online.
President Akufo-Addo said the Ghana.gov portal, in place since 2019, has facilitated government transactions, with no count of services given.
Citi Newsroom reports the Lands Commission's online portal lets buyers upload a site plan, pay the search fee and receive a land search report by email, live in 10 of 16 regions.
MyJoyOnline reports the Petroleum Commission's chief executive announced a Digital Permit Application Platform replacing hard-copy permit applications in the upstream petroleum sector.
Deputy Chief of Staff Nana Oye Bampoe Addo said the Passport Office has digitalised passport applications, with applicants reporting faster services.
